caption: Cinnamon Apricot Granola Bars Full recipe ⬇️ 💛 Easy and the most beautiful- No Bake Apricot Gronalo Bars  * 200 g / 7oz dried apricots plus extra for decoration * 100 g dried cranberries or cherries plus extra for decorating  * 4 tbsp maple syrup * 1 teaspoon cinnamon  * 2 tbsp honey (feel free to add a little more syrup or honey for extra sweetness)  * 100 g / 3.5oz coconut oil * 200 g / 7oz oats * 60 g / 2.1 hazelnuts * 60 g / 2.1oz almonds * 60 g / 2.1oz pumpkin seeds * 80 g / 2.8oz dark chocolate These keep for about a week, longer if in the fridge.  I like to add coconut oil to my chocolate pieces for a better dipping consistency. 1-2 teaspoons to a cup of chocolate.  Roasting the oats and nuts first would taste lovely!#fallideas #nobake #homemadegifts #homemade
